passives.name: The More the Merrier
passives.description: (Passive Effect) At the start of battle, grants an irremovable reduced damage taken to the caster for [Buff_T_tower_very_hard_common_dmg_reduce_single] turn(s). Always grants Buff Enhancement to the caster. This effect is irremovable. Increases damage dealt by all attacks proportional to the number of buffs granted to the caster. At the start of the turn, recovers Weakness Gauge by [Buff_V_tower_very_hard_boss_2000012_4_2].
